title: PoP revoked
description: An operator revoked a PoP relay, which ends its link to the fleet and the outside copies of its broadcasts (R74, docs/76). The event names the PoP and nothing else about it: never an address, a pairing string or a credential. The `data` of a `fi.ioio.gawk.pop.revoked` CloudEvent.

pop.description: The PoP the operator acted on: the Pop resource's name.

displayName.description: The PoP's name as shown to people.
